feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Data center divides North Carolina county
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep visits the site of a future data center in Stokes County, North Carolina.

entry.title: 'There's a lot to be done': North Carolina continues recovery from Hurricane Helene
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep visits communities still recovering from Hurricane Helene two years later.

entry.title: North Carolina and Georgia are research hubs. How Trump's cuts have affected them
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep explores how the Trump administration's policies have impacted public health research in NC and GA.

entry.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

entry.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
entry.summary: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.

entry.title: Activists decry the clearing 250-year-old trees for border wall expansion
entry.summary: Protesters in Arizona are decrying the removal of 250-year-old cottonwood trees for border wall expansion. This after a judge temporarily halted it in and near Big Bend National Park in Texas.

entry.title: Trump to close and renovate D.C. golf course, despite legal battle
entry.summary: President Trump continues his efforts to remake Washington, D.C. He wants to turn an area used by the public into a world-class golf course.

entry.title: Disgruntled farmers may help flip Senate seat in Kansas
entry.summary: President Trump heads to Kansas to campaign for Republican candidates Monday but farmers disgruntled by White House policies may help flip a U.S. Senate seat that Republicans have held for almost a century.

entry.title: Zoe Kazan on her adaptation of Steinbeck's East of Eden - and her grandfather's
entry.summary: Screenwriter Zoe Kazan talks about her adaptation of John Steinbeck's 1952 novel – a sprawling multigenerational epic that explores the nature of good and evil - streaming now on Netflix.

entry.title: Dad shift: Men now file majority of paid family leave claims in key states
entry.summary: The U.S. has no law guaranteeing paid parental leave. But in states with their own programs, more dads are using the benefit to bond with their new children, exceeding moms in some states.
